verdict.rationale: Vapi documents a Server URL that receives event messages over HTTP, such as a `tool-calls` message when tools fire. Its CLI also forwards webhooks to a local endpoint, so outbound HTTP callbacks a programmatic consumer can receive clearly exist. However, the evidence only shows the tool-call event and does not document how to choose which events to subscribe to, so full coverage of the story is not established. Missing for 10: a documented catalog of subscribable event types (e.g. call status, end-of-call reports), per-event subscription/registration configuration, webhook signing/verification and retry semantics, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: When tools are triggered, your Server URL receives a `tool-calls` message
Forward webhooks to your local server for debugging
Assistants can ping your server to perform actions.
